name: Pet Rescue (Harrison, NY)
region_note: EMERGENCY VETS JUST OUTSIDE THE CITY - from AmbuVet's after-hours list (2026-11-15), each checked on its own site; for nights when one of these is the nearest 24-hour hospital
notes: A volunteer-run no-kill group founded in 1982. It cares for dogs, cats, puppies, kittens and animals with special needs until they are adopted, many of them in volunteers' foster homes, and has a kennel and a space for adult cats in Harrison. Its animals come from owners who can no longer keep them, from kill shelters and from the streets. Mailing address: P.O. Box 393, Larchmont, NY 10538. Bully Baby Rescue brings dogs to New York through it. Outside the city, in Westchester.
